description: PictureSharp 0.6.3 graphics operations; generated by tests/assets/graphics_reference.py

tone.levels_formula: ob + (ow - ob) * clamp((x - ib) / (iw - ib), 0, 1) ^ (1 / gamma), double, floor(v + 0.5)
tone.oracle: levels/gamma: exact LUT; autocontrast/equalize: Pillow 10.2.0 ImageOps on RGB, alpha unchanged

trim.background_distance: max |channel difference| over RGBA; default background is the top-left pixel; alpha-0 pixels match an alpha-0 background

mask.formula: A' = (A * v * 2 + 255) / 510 (integer); v = mask alpha or BT.601 luma

blend.oracle: W3C Compositing and Blending Level 1 separable modes, source-over, double precision, straight alpha, floor(v * 255 + 0.5); linear_light decodes/encodes sRGB around the blend
